result.question: For what did Abimelech use the seventy shekels of silver?

readings.answer: To hire some worthless and reckless men to follow him.
readings.support: with which Abimelech hired some worthless and reckless men to follow him.

assessments.reason: The passage states he used the seventy shekels “with which Abimelech hired some worthless and reckless men to follow him,” matching the answer.

result.reason: The verse directly says the silver was used to hire worthless and reckless men to follow Abimelech.
